insert into asm_stat_minute (data_time, logic_device_unique_id, attr_id, interval_mode, avg_value, value_text, valid_count, total_count, updated_at) values
(#{item.dataTime, typeHandler=com.ecat.integration.EnvAirStationManagerIntegration.support.TimestamptzInstantTypeHandler}, #{item.logicDeviceUniqueId}, #{item.attrId}, #{item.intervalMode}, #{item.avgValue}, #{item.valueText}, #{item.validCount}, #{item.totalCount}, now())
on conflict (data_time, logic_device_unique_id, attr_id, interval_mode) do update set avg_value = excluded.avg_value, value_text = excluded.value_text, valid_count = excluded.valid_count, total_count = excluded.total_count, updated_at = now()
